title: Municipalidad de Cieneguilla
description: municieneguilla.gob.pe Municipalidad Distrital de Cieneguilla is the local government of the Cieneguilla district in Lima Province, Peru, serving approximately 100,000 residents in a growing agricultural and tourism area along the Río Lurín. Led by Mayor Emilio Alberto Chávez Huaringa with 42 employees, it operates a digital services platform including virtual document submission, property tax queries, pet registration and sports facility booking. Key projects include the 2027–2029 Multi-Year Investment Plan, participatory budgeting and an inter-agency initiative to recover the Río Lurín ecosystem. The municipality promotes Cieneguilla as a natural refuge near Lima through a dedicated tourism portal showcasing local gastronomy, agriculture and outdoor activities. Transparency measures include a public accountability portal, public hearings and annual reporting to the Comptroller General. Staff grew by 162 percent as the municipality expanded digital and social inclusion programs.
